summary: Tested the Radar sources-quality improvement: new /api/careeros/radar/directory endpoint (26 Canadian employers live-verified against Workday/SuccessFactors/Oracle/SmartRecruiters, ~22 ok with offer counts, 5 marked 'no public feed → Jooble'), new /api/careeros/radar/portal/discover endpoint (returns candidates from annuaire + site scan + guessed ATS slugs, Desjardins returns 2 Workday candidates with origin='annuaire' and 'devinette', unknown company returns empty candidates list), and enhanced /api/careeros/radar/portal/detect which now probes SuccessFactors when regex ATS matching fails (hydroquebec.com now returns ok=True kind=successfactors count=20 — this was previously 'unknown'). Added 6 new backend tests (test_portal_detect_successfactors_probe, test_portal_detect_unknown_host, test_directory_endpoint, test_portal_discover_desjardins, test_portal_discover_unknown, test_portal_discover_requires_auth) and updated the stale test_portal_detect assertion that still expected ok=False for Hydro-Québec. 29/29 radar backend tests now pass (1 skipped: pack IPS generation is async). Frontend end-to-end verified on preview URL interview-ai-engine.preview.emergentagent.com (login via /connexion → /careeros/radar): PortalHealth card renders '8 configuré(s) · Lecture réussie : 7/8 (88 %)' with per-portal rows. Réglages → CompanyManager shows Annuaire toggle → EmployerDirectory loads all 26 entries, filter 'Desjardins' narrows to 1 row and shows 'Suivie' chip (already followed). PortalSuggest (loupe icon) on Desjardins returns 2 Workday candidates with 'Associer' buttons. Jooble shows 'Non configuré' chip as expected (no JOOBLE_KEY in preview). Privacy banner correctly dismissed via localStorage privacyAcceptedV2='1' (did not touch .env).
critical_code_review_comments: radar_discovery.py (163 lines) stays well below the 700-line threshold and cleanly separates: directory_match → verify → discover → directory with proper 6h caching on _cache for /directory. Good.

DIRECTORY contains 26 Canadian employers; 5 have url='' (Banque Nationale, Bell, Air Canada, Metro, CGI) which are correctly surfaced as 'Portail sans flux public : suivi via Jooble' in the UI — matches spec.
/directory response time ~15-20s on cold cache (26 live httpx calls in parallel) is acceptable; _cache 6h TTL avoids repeat cost. EmployerDirectory component loads it async so UI isn't blocked.

detect_portal() now does a SuccessFactors probe when regex matching fails and host exists — this fixes the Hydro-Québec case cleanly. test_portal_detect in the original suite was stale and has been updated.
/portal/discover has a hard 45s timeout wrapper → returns a friendly 'Détection trop longue' message with Jooble fallback — good UX.

Frontend EmployerDirectory, PortalHealth, PortalSuggest, CompanyManager all have proper data-testid coverage (employer-directory, employer-directory-filter, employer-{name}, employer-add-{name}, radar-portal-health, portal-configured, portal-success-rate, portal-row-{name}, portal-suggest-{i}, portal-website-{i}, portal-discover-run-{i}, portal-candidate-{i}-{kind}, portal-associate-{i}-{kind}, portal-message-{i}, radar-directory-toggle, radar-detect-all-btn).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_radar.py (replaced stale Hydro-Québec test with 6 new tests for SuccessFactors probe, directory endpoint, portal/discover endpoint happy+unknown+auth paths)

success_rate.frontend: 100% core flows (PortalHealth renders, EmployerDirectory loads 26 entries + filter, PortalSuggest returns Workday candidates for Desjardins)

seed_data_creation: None. Radar runs were triggered during tests but data is user-scoped and does not pollute production flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Radar portals quality is stable. /api/careeros/radar/directory is cached 6h — if tests look flaky after cache miss, give it ~25s on first call. test_portal_detect was updated: Hydro-Québec is now detected as SuccessFactors (ok=True) — this is the intended new behavior. If you need to re-run the whole radar suite in parallel with xdist, note that TestCron.test_cron_correct_secret may trigger a background run that briefly collides with TestRadarRun.test_dedupe_second_run (409 'already running') on gw1 — the test passes serially. Jooble key is intentionally absent in preview so by_source.jooble.fetched == 0 is expected.
